# FlashInfer SM120 sparse MLA headers

This directory is part of the complete FlashInfer `v0.6.16.post1` header
snapshot vendored from commit `5f3d1b3fc6e1ed8a79429986b3637802f1bd2b57`.
The snapshot source and version are documented in
`third_party/flashinfer/README.md`.

The NVIDIA-authored sparse-MLA files retain their BSD-3-Clause notices in each
source file.  FlashInfer's upstream Apache-2.0 license is vendored at
`third_party/flashinfer/LICENSE`.
